scope: The standing Lahore Fort enclosure, its perimeter walls and bastions, the Alamgiri and Akbari gates, the north Picture Wall and the principal mapped palace, audience and mosque ensembles inside. The neighboring Badshahi Mosque, Hazuri Bagh and Iqbal tomb fall separately outside the enclosure.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The fort authority lists the palace and audience quadrangles, major interior structures and historic enclosure, including the south stair through a former wall section.
The authority confirms the west-facing entrance, paired fluted semicircular bastions and lotus bases, domed pavilions and central Mughal arch.
The conservation survey identifies the court complexes, royal kitchen, Akbari Gate and the north Picture Wall sections.
The restored Picture Wall occupies the inner northern and western facades and has an average height of about 17 m.
The pavilion west of Sheesh Mahal is a small marble rectangle under a strongly curved roof.
The eastern gate has two brick storeys with chambers and a broad former elephant entrance.
